title: Live reference functionality and keybinding inventory

source_scope.platform_notation: Ctrl-based Windows/Linux notation as captured; actual operating system and Live version are not independently established.
source_scope.purpose: Screenshot reference only. Not an Alive implementation specification or claim of implemented functionality.
source_scope.state_semantics: Enabled, disabled, highlighted and visible checkmarks describe only this captured context. Disabled does not mean permanently unavailable. A false visible_checkmark means no checkmark is visible, not necessarily a toggle command.
source_scope.shortcut_semantics: Null means no shortcut displayed in the captured row, not that no shortcut exists. Labels and modifier ordering are transcribed as shown.
limitations: Eight user-provided screenshot crops only. No hidden submenu commands inferred.
View appears in the menu bar but its expanded menu is not captured. No View show/hide shortcuts are established by this inventory.
Most menu headings are cropped; those menu paths are categorized from visible command groups and explicitly identified in source metadata.
Edit menu is scrollable and incomplete.
source_scope.alive_assessment: Session 5 maps all captured rows conservatively. Supported equivalents may differ in format, scope or shortcut; proposed_unverified is not an implementation or a proof of permanent unavailability.
